data.summary:
Strategic Cloud/DevOps Leadership: A seasoned DevOps & Cloud Engineer with over 12 years of industry experience, specialized in designing and implementing a matured DevOps culture. Advocate for current trends, including AI/ML, GitOps, and DevSecOps, with a strong emphasis on automation and enhanced security. Platform Engineering leadership: Leaded team for Design & Implementation of platform engineering solutions to organizations, development of IDP - Skystage, using Backstage. Cloud-Native Expertise: Proven expertise in designing and implementing robust cloud-native solutions on GCP and AWS. Excel at leveraging tools like Terraform to provision infrastructure and orchestrating complex deployments with Kubernetes and Openshift. CI/CD Pipeline Mastery: A track record of designing, optimizing, and managing comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using Codefresh, Jenkins, and IBM Urban Code Deploy to streamline development-to-production workflows and accelerate time-to-market. Enhanced Security & Observability: Dedicated to integrating security and monitoring as core components of the SDLC. Extensive experience with security scanning tools like Twistlock, Checkmarx, Blackduck and observability platforms like Dynatrace and Splunk, Prometheus & Grafana to ensure high-performance and resilient systems. Mentorship & Collaboration: Skilled at leading and collaborating with cross-functional teams to foster a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge transfer, and operational excellence. Education & Credentials M.Tech. | Computer Networks & Engineering, RV College of Engineering| Bangalore (2010) B.E. – Information Science & Engineering, JVIT, Bangalore (2007) Technical Skills AI: Vertex AI, GitHub Copilot, GPT, Gemini, Claude Sonnet Cloud Platforms: AWS, GCP Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift CI/CD Tools: Jenkins, Bamboo, IBM Urban Code Deploy, Codefresh, GitHub Actions Automation & IaC: Helm, Flux CD, Ansible, Terraform Monitoring & Observability: Dynatrace, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana Scripting & Programming: Shell, Python Version Control & Repositories: GitHub Enterprise, Bitbucket, SVN, JFrog Artifactory Security & Quality Tools: SonarQube, Fortify, Twistlock, Checkmarx, Blackduck, Snyk Achievements Rewards & Recognition – ANZ (2023): Helmization & migration to Codefresh Take Charge and Excel – ANZ (2020) You Make a Difference – Sapient Global Markets (2018) Key Impact Areas Key Skills Certifications AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner Career Timeline Professional Experience WellSky India Pvt.Ltd, Bangalore (Subsidiary of Wellsky Foundation, US) |Sr.Staff Software Engineer|Cloud|DevOps| Team Lead | Oct 2025 – Till date Lead the design and implementation of Internal Developer Portal – Skystage using backstage and integration with JSM incident management system. Lead cross-functional teams through all stages of development, from concept to deployment and post-launch monitoring. Lead adoption of best practices across engineering teams, promote solution innovation, and research and evaluate new technologies, tools, AI capabilities, and methodologies that improve the efficiency, scalability, and performance of WellSky solutions. Lead the strategic design and execution of infrastructure and cloud-native solutions on GCP, using Github Actions, Spacelift, Azure DevOps, and ArgoCD. Influence the use of automated testing, continuous integration, and delivery (CI/CD) processes, and promote high standards of code quality, testing, and operational reliability. ANZ Operations & Technology – Bangalore | Cloud Engineer|                                                                        Oct 2019 – Sept 2025 Designing and automating environment provisioning pipelines for GCP platform, integrating Flux CD for namespace management in GKE. Building custom automation scripts for request validation, Vault integrations, and Slack notifications setup for GCP Environment Fabricator project. Delivering key projects, including NPP Cloud, Apigee-Hybrid, and WDCD Platform Services (2020–2023). Leading helmization and migration of Transaction Banking applications to OpenShift4, optimizing resource usage and ensuring smooth cutover from OCP3. Enhancing security and observability by integrating tools like Vault, Sonarqube, Fortify Scanner, Dynatrace, and Splunk. Providing release support and resolving production environment issues. Migrating CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins to Codefresh, enabling faster deployments and enhancing observability. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to foster a matured DevOps culture. Publicis Sapient – Bangalore |Senior DevOps Engineer |                                                                                 May 2019 – Sep 2019 Implemented monitoring with Dynatrace and Splunk for OpenShift applications. Automated deployments from IBM UCD to OpenShift for microservices, improving release efficiency. Designed & implemented UCD deployment workflow for Websphere Liberty 
 NLB Services Pvt. Ltd. – Noida/Bangalore |DevOps Engineer |                                                                    Apr 2017 – May 2019 Automated WebSphere Liberty upgrades and deployments via UCD. Streamlined Bamboo build pipelines, integrating Fortify scans and automated release notes. Developed secure SSL and MQ configurations for critical banking apps. Vengai Software Solutions – Hyderabad | Technical Consultant |                                                                    Dec 2012 – Mar 2017 Implemented Ansible-based automation for SVN/Jenkins installations. Set up centralized login via OpenLDAP and Ansible for Linux servers. Built CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, Maven, and WebLogic server. CI/CD enhancements. ANZ OPERATIONS & TECHNOLOGY 2. NPP Cloud 2025
Platform Service Engineer, DevOps | 8 Members | GCP
Tools: Codefresh, Terraform, Python, Shell, GitHub, Flux CD Developed request validation scripts and schemas for “Environment Fabricator” (automated GKE environment provisioning). Integrated Vault with PR commenter tool (ODIN) and configured Slack/Git notifications. Automated namespace provisioning and GCP decommissioning processes. 3. Apigee-Hybrid 2024

Tools: Codefresh, Helm, Terraform Automated API enablement, firewall rule setup, static IP reservation, DNS zone & wildcard creation in GCP using Terraform. 4. WDCD Platform Service 2023

Tools: Codefresh, Helm Helmized Transaction Banking apps and migrated to OpenShift 4. Migrated pipelines from OCP3 Jenkins to Codefresh & OCP4 Jenkins. Performed environment setup, Vault integration, pipeline creation, quota optimization, and OCP3 service shutdown. 5. WDCD Platform Service 2022

Tools: Maven, WebLogic 12c, Jenkins, SVN, SonarQube Automated builds/deployments with Jenkins/WLST, managed JMS, Coherence clusters, and Nginx setup. 13. ESI-CSP Foundation Design & Build Phase 2
